name: Light of Foliar Incision
passiveDesc: CRIT Rate is increased by 4%/5%/6%/7%/8%. After Normal Attacks deal Elemental DMG, the Foliar Incision effect will be obtained, increasing DMG dealt by Normal Attacks and Elemental Skills by 120%/150%/180%/210%/240% of Elemental Mastery. This effect will disappear after 28 DMG instances or 12s. You can obtain Foliar Incision once every 12s.

modifiers.label: Foliar Incision: additional Normal Attack DMG from Elemental Mastery while active
Foliar Incision: additional Elemental Skill DMG from Elemental Mastery while active
